decisive_items: The central mesenteric vessels exhibited a spiral (whirl) pattern, with congestion of mesenteric fat and stretching and convergence of vessels
a cluster of small-bowel loops in the left upper quadrant, positioned anterior to the splenic flexure
response.rationale: CT shows the classic whirl sign and abnormal small-bowel loop position, highly specific for internal hernia after Roux-en-Y gastric bypass. R3 names the same diagnosis but lacks the discriminative imaging detail.

rejected.why: No CT evidence of obstruction; prior surgery history is nonspecific and symptoms are better explained by internal hernia.
Normal CRP and lactate, no strangulation or obstruction on CT; ischemia is not supported by available objective findings.
